context: You have an upcoming knee appointment with Dr. Lukowski. It has been moved before, so you are not sure exactly when it is now.
goal: Move your knee appointment to a weekday morning next week. Do NOT accept anything this week or in the afternoon. If they offer something that doesn't fit, say it doesn't work and ask again for a morning next week. If they can't find any upcoming appointment, book a new one in that window instead.
twist: After they read back a time to confirm, change your mind and ask for a slightly later time on the same day.
